title: Cascade Session Invalidation & Token Revocation
description: Implement password reset session invalidation that blacklists active refresh tokens across all clusters.
explicit_requirements: Invalidate user sessions on password change
derived_requirements: Update token blacklist with TTL matching max token lifetime

required_behavior: Immediate rejection of blacklisted tokens on next request
Set revoked_at timestamp on session record
forbidden_behavior: Allowing old JWTs to access protected endpoints after password reset

failure_taxonomy.description: Old access/refresh token remains valid after credential change.

ground_truth_rationale: Authentication security requires immediate distributed token invalidation without modifying crypto keys.
